description: This file defines the ImpactItem class, which represents impact items within the Goteo project. It includes properties, methods for CRUD operations, retrieval based on related data, and validation logic.

classes.name: ImpactItem
classes.description: Represents an impact item with properties such as id, name, description, and unit; provides methods for data retrieval, persistence, and validation.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-specific and require localization.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the impact item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the impact item.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the impact item.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the impact item.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the impact item.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the impact item.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Returns the measurement unit of the impact item.

methods.name: setUnit
methods.description: Sets the measurement unit of the impact item.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactItem instance by its ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getByImpactData
methods.description: Fetches all ImpactItems associated with given ImpactData.

methods.name: getByImpactDataAndProject
methods.description: Fetches ImpactItems associated with given ImpactData and Project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactItem to the database after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that required properties are set; collects errors if validation fails.
